sourceSentences: Enemy champions and large monsters hit will leave a Dusk Trail behind while moving.
While on the Dusk Trail, Nocturne is ghosted and gains bonus attack damage and bonus total movement speed.

Duskbringer's Dusk Trail will expose the path of affected units until its duration ends. It is a form of obscured vision; the trail indirectly reveals the location of enemy units even in the fog of war, including those shrouded by stealth.
The formed Dusk Trail does not disappear if Duskbringer is intercepted by Wind Wall or Unbreakable.
Active: Nocturne gains a spell shield for 1.5 seconds. Upon successfully blocking a hostile effect, Shroud of Darkness' bonus attack speed is doubled for 5 seconds.
If Shroud of Darkness is active when Nocturne re-casts Paranoia to dash to a target, its duration is refreshed every 0.25 seconds during the dash.
Spell shield will block the tether's application but not the damage and aftereffects of one already applied.
If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is feared for a duration while being slowed by 90%.
Nocturne can cast any of his abilities and item actives during the dash.
Using a dash or blink ability will interrupt the flight.
Basic attacks reduce Umbra Blades' cooldown by 1 second, increased to 3 against enemy champions and monsters.
For combos start with Q into E and attack away. Try to get behind them to fear them in the wrong direction while using W to block a key ability.
When starting ult you should ultimate and you can use W while traveling to extend the length of it. Upon landing use Q into your E and then spam away with more attacks.
When ganking it's all about landing your Q into your fear.
Cool thing about it is you can actually use it during your ultimate
Cool things about it is you can cast it midair.
The most of the time, you just need to hit the Q right before you're about to hit land.
You W before you go in, Q, stridebreaker, E, and you're pretty much all abilities down on the target.
I have him feared, so I'm kind of put him away from the the wall, right? I know he's looking to flash over the wall there.
Here, you can spell shield, and it actually procs your bonus attack speed from your W passive.
